kits.name: core
kits.summary: Seeded randomness, simplex noise, math helpers, a frame loop with clamped dt, a boot screen wired to GCP, quality picking, safe storage.

kits.name: input
kits.summary: Keyboard, mouse (with pointer lock) and touch (virtual stick + buttons) behind one object: move axis, look deltas, pressed/down.

kits.name: three-kit
kits.summary: Three.js helpers: renderer setup with resize and context-loss handling, canvas-painted textures, material cache, merged vertex-colour meshes, lumpy organic shapes, instancing, gradient sky, a shadowed sun that follows the player, terrain geometry, disposal.

kits.name: canvas2d
kits.summary: 2D canvas helpers: DPR-aware canvas, sprites baked once to offscreen canvases, a camera, y-sorted drawing, cached ground chunks.

kits.name: audio
kits.summary: Synthesised sound with no audio files: tones, noise bursts, mute, automatic unlock on the first gesture.

kits.name: net
kits.summary: Host-authoritative multiplayer on GCP.room: the host simulates and broadcasts snapshots, guests send inputs; includes snapshot interpolation.
